 BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE MRIDUL KUMAR KALITA

Heard Mr. F. Haque, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Also heard Ms. N. Das, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. This application under Section 482 of BNSS has been filed by the petitioner, namely, Joynal Abedin, who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Goalpara P.S. Case No. 46/2025 under Sections 120(B)/420/409 of IPC.

sentences.text: 1 3. The gist of accusation in this case is that on 06.03.2025, one Jamela Khatun had lodged an FIR before the Officer-in-charge of Goalpara Police Station, inter alia, alleging that in the year 2023-2024, a PMAY house was allotted to the informant and after the said allotment, one Nasir Uddin Sheikh, who is the ward member of Ward No. 7 of Milonpur village took the bank account details of the informant along with photos.
However, the sanction money was not deposited in the account of the informant.

It is further stated that later on she came to know that the sanction amount was deposited in the account of father of the said Nasir Uddin Sheikh and thereby it is alleged that the said Nasir Uddin Sheikh has misappropriated the money which was sanctioned to the informant.

4. The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner has not named in the FIR,
however, he has been repeatedly called by the police in connection with this case and, therefore, he is apprehending his arrest.
He further submits that he petitioner is presently posted in the Block Development Office, Gauripur and he is ready to co-operate in the investigation.
5. On the other hand, Additional Public Prosecutor has prayed for calling of the case diary.

6. Let the case diary be called for.
7.
List this matter again on 27th of June, 2025.

8. In the meanwhile, considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner as discussed in the forgoing paragraph, the above named petitioner is directed to appear before the Investigating Officer of Goalpara P.S. Case No. 46/2025 within a period of ten days from the date of this order and co-operate in the investigation.
